Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:83156: kernel security update (Important)
Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: net/sched: act_ct: Only release RCU read lock after ct_ft (CVE-2026-46319)

* kernel: net/sched: taprio: fix use-after-free in advance_sched() on schedule switch (CVE-2026-53011)

* kernel: wifi: mac80211: bounds-check link_id in ieee80211_ml_epcs (CVE-2026-64030)

* kernel: wifi: cfg80211: use wiphy work for socket owner autodisconnect (CVE-2026-68404)

* kernel: Linux kernel: Denial of Service due to use-after-free in act_tunnel_key (CVE-2026-68377)

* kernel: net/iucv: fix use-after-free of a severed iucv_path (CVE-2026-68140)

* kernel: wifi: mac80211: defer link RX stats percpu free to RCU (CVE-2026-68409)

* kernel: KVM: arm64: vgic: Handle race between interrupt affinity change and LPI disabling (CVE-2026-72288)

* kernel: ASoC: SOF: ipc3-control: Fix heap overflow in bytes_ext put/get (CVE-2026-72262)

* kernel: netfilter: nft_lookup: fix catchall element handling with inverted lookups (CVE-2026-72320)

* kernel: ALSA: usx2y: bound the hwdep mmap fault offset (CVE-2026-74641)

* kernel: udp: fix potential use-after-free in tunnel segmentation (CVE-2026-74705)

* kernel: net/smc: carry oversized SMC-Rv2 LLC messages in the queue entry (CVE-2026-80985)

* kernel: svcrdma: Validate Read chunk positions before reconstruction (CVE-2026-89526)

* kernel: net/iucv: filter frames in afiucv_hs_rcv() by ingress device (CVE-2026-81003)

* kernel: NFSD: Prevent client use-after-free during blocked-lock reaping (CVE-2026-90036)

* kernel: SUNRPC: Zero rpc_gss_wire_cred at svcauth_gss_decode_credbody() entry (CVE-2026-93207)

* kernel: svcrdma: Reject Write/Reply chunks with segcount 0 (CVE-2026-93228)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
